overall_summary: The channel shows early traction in 'self respect' (e.g., AfaLxMy6FMY with 40 views) and grounded relationship topics like phone numbers and chat logs, while abstract emotional topics like late-night thoughts underperform due to low sample sizes and generic formatting.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video AfaLxMy6FMY ('चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत और खुद की इज्जत') achieved the highest views (40) by focusing on an active decision rather than passive sadness.
winning_patterns.action: Create more scenarios involving definitive boundaries like muting, deleting, or removing someone from priority lists.

winning_patterns.evidence: Hooks involving specific UI elements like 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' (AfaLxMy6FMY) or 'बिना नाम के सेव किया था नंबर' (aNR94Xxn0yM) outperformed vague emotional statements.
winning_patterns.action: Use specific smartphone interaction triggers as hooks for relatability.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing purely on time and vague feelings like 'रात के दो बजे' (G0gKV1p3ZHc) or 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (uIbMpCjVutQ) had the lowest view counts (5-12 views).
weak_patterns.action: Ground abstract late-night themes into tangible smartphone or daily routine actions.
